description_en: Retrieves the details of a workspace
description_zh: 获取工作空间详细信息
name: GetWorkspace

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return additional information, such as the workspace owner. Valid values:

- false (default): Does not return additional information.

- true: Returns additional information
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示工作空间Owner等补充信息。取值如下：
- false（默认值）：不显示补充信息。
- true：显示补充信息
parameters.name: verbose
